description: Guided opt-out for Hunter, which lists people by email address. One opt-out covers every saved email address.
instructions: Hunter shows people's work email addresses. کھولیں https://hunter.io/ and click "Do Not Sell My Info" at the bottom. For each of these addresses, claim it, open the link Hunter sends to it, then press "Delete my information": {all_emails}. پھر "میں نے یہ کر لیا" دبائیں۔
